content.text: GET UP TO $60,000IN INCENTIVES WHEN YOU JOIN CBPCareer PathsU.S. Customs and Border Protection Spring Virtual Career ExpoRegister today for U.S. Customs and Border Protection Spring Virtual Career Expo on March 31, from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM ET. Learn more about our mission and how you could contribute to it, making a positive impact on yourself, your community, and your country.Register NowSecurity and Facilitation: A Winning CombinationCBP is dedicated to ensuring the safety and success of the FIFA World Cup 2026™. Through extensive planning and collaboration, CBP will facilitate secure cross-border movements for athletes, officials, fans, and visitors while upholding public safety. Join us and make a difference at events like this.Learn MoreFinancial Incentives for New Border Patrol Agents, CBP Officers, and Air and Marine AgentsBegin your career with CBP and enjoy outstanding benefits. Newly hired Border Patrol Agents, CBP Officers, and Air and Marine Agents may qualify for up to $60,000 in recruitment and retention incentives. Ready to join our team?Learn MoreBe An Agent of ServiceWhen you join U.S. Border Patrol, you volunteer to serve your nation by protecting Americans from dangerous narcotics like methamphetamine and fentanyl, weapons, and the individuals attempting to smuggle them across our borders.Join Our Talent NetworkBorder Patrol Agent Reinstatement OpportunityFormer Border Patrol Agents, CBP is currently offering a reinstatement opportunity! Positions are located nationwide. Find out how to apply today.Apply NowNow HiringCBP is currently offering a reinstatement opportunity for former supervisory Border Patrol Agents. Positions are located nationwide. Find out how to apply today.Apply NowCBP operates in all 50 states, its territories, in over 50 countries, and at 328 ports of entry to protect the American people, safeguard our borders, and enhance the nation’s economic prosperity. Your journey begins here.A Career With PurposeWhat is great about Border Patrol is that there is a place for everybody. Border Patrol really encourages and gives you the opportunity to grow, to learn, to develop professionally and personally and gives you a career with incredible purpose in protecting your community and the Nation. What you do really does have a direct effect on the entire United States.Border Patrol Agent LeeCareer Advancement OpportunitiesOffice of Field Operations has a lot to offer, which allows you to find an area that fits you the best. There are many trainings and temporary duties available to help you advance your career and take advantage of the many opportunities available to you, e.g., Non-Intrusive Inspection Trainer, National Recruiter or a member of the Special Response Team.CBP Officer JamesMake an Impact in Your CommunityI love the culture here because I’m always learning something new. No assignment is ever the same. I also think about the impact of my work on a daily basis; whenever I’m in the grocery store or shopping for clothes, I think about where the stuff I’m buying came from and how it got here.International Trade Analyst CorinneFinding the Perfect CareerImagine taking what you believed was just a job and staying there 22 years to make it a career – that is my story. There are so many places you can go in CBP and so much to learn. I honestly couldn’t recommend a better place to be.Supervisory Security Specialist RachelA Culture of LearningI have found myself in a career that I love that brings me personal happiness. CBP has given me the opportunity to train with some of the most talented people and offered me training to build my skills and abilities. Few organizations support employee development like CBP.Management and Program Analyst MarissaApr 4, 2026- Apr 5, 2026Spartan San Jose Trifecta 2026Oakdale, CAApr 7, 2026USBP Recruitment Webinar - April 7, 2026OnlineApr 8, 2026UNT All Majors Career Fair Spring 2026Denton, TX
